description:
“Evidence of physical characteristics” shall include fingerprints, palm prints, footprints, physical measurements, handwriting and hand-printing samples, blood samples, urine samples, saliva samples, fingernail scrapings, hair samples, photographs, voice exemplars, display of designated portions of the body, the taking of photographs and appearance in a lineup.

Note: Adopted July 26, 1984 to be effective September 10, 1984.
